integrity: Exact standard-library enumeration, canonical tree isomorphism reduction and complete subset counts are included. Underlying graph polynomial and its known ten-vertex collision are expressly credited to prior literature; no independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Simple undirected unweighted tree networks with known number of taxa only.
The entire uniform fixed-cardinality sampled-edge-count probability law is assumed available exactly; estimation from noisy or limited replicates is not addressed.
Complete optimal depth classifications are proved only for tree orders four through nine; the ten-taxon full-data collision is previously known.
The nine-taxon design classification is based on an exhaustively proved finite census; no claim about all larger tree orders is made.
title: Optimal census-depth recovery of tree-shaped ecological interaction networks
